record.paper_title: Some open problems in low dimensional dynamical systems
record.original_question: For a general T-periodic Riccati differential equation ẋ = A₂(t)x² + A₁(t)x + A₀(t), give effective criteria that determine whether it has a continuum of periodic solutions or exactly 2, 1, or 0 limit cycles.

evidence.quote: Problem 5. For a general T periodic Riccati diﬀerential equation dx/dt =A2(t)x2 +A1(t)x +A0(t) give eﬀective criteria to know when it has a continuum of periodic solutions, or it has exactly 2, 1 or 0 limit cycles.

artifact.category_tag: periodic Riccati equations and limit cycles
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of effective criteria to distinguish between a continuum of periodic solutions and exactly 0, 1, or 2 limit cycles for general T-periodic scalar Riccati equations appears to remain open. Recent work (e.g., on the "weak-Coppel problem" for Riccati equations, 2025) and earlier studies provide partial results — bounds on the number of periodic solutions, conditions for existence of two, and analyses for special subclasses — but no general effective criterion in terms of the coefficients is established.

status_evidence.title: Weak-Coppel problem for a class of Riccati differential equations
status_evidence.snippet: Addresses bifurcation/Coppel-type questions for a class of Riccati equations, indicating the general problem remains under investigation.
status_evidence.claim: Research on characterizing the number of limit cycles of periodic Riccati equations is ongoing as of 2025.

status_evidence.title: A note on periodic solutions of Riccati equations
status_evidence.snippet: Partial results on the existence and number of periodic solutions of Riccati equations with periodic coefficients.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial conditions, not effective general criteria, are known.
